content: If the FrTpConnectionControl parameter FRTP_MULTIPLE_RECEIVER_CON (see section 10.2 ) for the corresponding FrTpConnection is set, the communication handler shall not process a segmentation of an N - SDU and take the following actions: a) shall raise a runtime error FRTP_E_SEG_ERROR and b) shall abort the transmission of this messag e and notify the upper layer by calling the callback function PduR_FrTpTxConfirmation with the result E_NOT_OK.
